title: Canadian Kissed Stew
description: A hearty stew made with tender tofu and kissed by the flavors of Canada.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Press and drain tofu before use

ingredients.name: Canadian kissed
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality Canadian kissed oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality paste for best flavor

instructions: Heat the Canadian kissed oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the diced carrots, potatoes, and celery. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the vegetable broth, tomato paste, and stew seasoning. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the pressed and drained tofu to the stew. Simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
